name: The Art Gallery of NSW's Naala Badu: the land bridge over the Eastern Distributor and the Cahill Expressway

cover.why: The land bridge, with Naala Badu's south-west pavilions and the Art Garden on it, over the Cowper Wharf Road Offramp (way 173918035) to OSM's portal at (979, -669), and over the Cahill's tubes. The elevation data has its top 5.3-6.1 m over the off-ramp's road, under TUNNEL_COVER, which left it a trench from 51 m along to its end. Drawn clear of the open trench under Art Gallery Rd's bridge (x 879-896) and of the Cahill's and Sir John Young Cres's portals south-east of it. Its top: the ground over the off-ramp's tube 0.3 m over its ceiling, where the elevation data has it up to 0.7 m under (you'd see into the tube along its north-east side from s 59 to 131)
